query:
SELECT
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE av.raw_app = false)::BIGINT AS "low_code!",
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE av.raw_app = true)::BIGINT AS "raw!"
           FROM app a
           JOIN app_version av ON av.id = a.versions[array_upper(a.versions, 1)]
           WHERE a.policy->>'sandbox' = 'true'
